entries.name: Beast Tide
entries.desc: Once a week the beasts come down on Stoneford Gate. Ring the gong to meet them.

entries.name: Spatial Rift
entries.desc: A tear opens in a field room for an hour. Touch it and the land's beasts pour out three levels stronger; beat them for what the rift leaves behind.

entries.name: The Drowned Shrine Surfaces
entries.desc: Every fifth day the shrine rises for a day and the Abbot wakes again. Repeat runs at Qi Unfurling 9 and below.

entries.name: The Waterfall Cave Opens
entries.desc: Every fifth day the falls thin and the cave's inner cache can be reached again. Repeat visits at Heart Tempering 9 and below.
